title: Bala de Baiana (Brazilian Coconut Candies)
summary: Chewy coconut condensed-milk balls in a crackly amber sugar shell.
difficulty_reason: Dipping in boiling hot caramel needs care and quick timing.

ingredients.line: 1 tbsp salted butter, plus extra to grease hands

steps: Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add the condensed milk and coconut flakes and stir 5 to 7 minutes, until thick and pulling away from the pan.
Scrape into a bowl, cover, and refrigerate until fully cooled.
With greased hands, roll the mixture into tablespoon-size balls and set them on a parchment-lined pan.
Push a toothpick into each ball.
Boil the sugar, water and vinegar in a clean saucepan, stirring occasionally, until amber. Take it off the heat.
Dip each ball quickly, swirl to coat, and set back on the parchment.
Let the candy shells cool and harden, then remove the toothpicks and serve.
tips: Work fast and carefully: the caramel is extremely hot and hardens quickly.
Chill the centers well so they hold their shape on the toothpicks.
